title.fr: Rotation d'un solide autour d'un axe fixe

sketch:
Observe: SVG disk with two marker points at r₁, r₂ from axis;
student sets θ̇ (angular velocity); linear speeds v₁ = r₁·θ̇,
v₂ = r₂·θ̇ shown as tangent arrows. Ticker rotates disk; angular
position θ(t) HUD. Experiment: 3 seeded (r, v-target) pairs; student
picks θ̇ so marker speed matches. Evaluate: arrows hidden; student
picks θ̇ from relationship alone. Wrinkle: solid-body constraint —
all points share same θ̇, θ̈, unlike orbital motion.
